## Question / Issue Description

<!--
Clearly describe your question or the issue you are facing.
What are you trying to do? What's not working as expected?
-->

## Steps Taken

<!--
List any steps you have already tried to resolve your question or work around the issue.
-->

## Environment & Context

<!--
Provide any relevant context:
- WordPress version
- PHP version
- Plugin/theme versions

-->

## Additional Context

<!--
Add any other context, screenshots, code snippets, logs, or links that might help us understand your question better.

-->

---

## Definition of Ready (DoR)

- [ ] Question or issue clearly described
- [ ] Steps taken provided
- [ ] Context/environment info attached (if applicable)

## Definition of Done (DoD)

- [ ] Issue resolved or answered
- [ ] Routed to correct template if it's actually a bug or feature request
- [ ] Maintainer saved reply used if applicable
- [ ] Documentation or help resources referenced (if needed)
